metric_definitions.label: macro-F1
metric_definitions.basis: plain choice reading: selected option with highest probability (default rule); mean of per-class F1 over answered labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: AUROC
metric_definitions.basis: genuine model probabilities; macro one-v-rest AUROC over options and answered labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: Brier score
metric_definitions.basis: genuine model probabilities; multiclass Brier score over answered labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: ECE
metric_definitions.basis: genuine model probabilities; calibration of selected-answer correctness over answered labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: accuracy (all)
metric_definitions.basis: configured primary objective; plain choice reading: selected option with highest probability (default rule); denominator: answered labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: coverage (target reference 95%)
metric_definitions.basis: target reference 0.95; target-specific CV chosen rule; observed accepted / answered labelled dev cases

metric_definitions.label: accepted accuracy (target reference 95%)
metric_definitions.basis: target reference 0.95; target-specific CV chosen rule; observed correct accepted / accepted labelled dev cases

question.instructions: 音声アシスタントへの依頼(utt)の意図を、選択肢から1つ選ぶ。選択肢は「シナリオ_動作」の形の名前。まず分野を決め、次に動作を選ぶ。完全に消すならlightoff、暗くするならlightdim。時差・UTC・標準時の指定があればdatetime_convert、現在の時刻や都市名だけならdatetime_query。「静かに」「黙って」はmute。「メール」の明示がない企業・相手への発信はsocial_post。「一番」など主観的な評価を問う質問はgeneral_quirky。
